answer: Each agent enters the harbor through one onyx credential that cannot be copied or transferred. Registering it mints a single nullifier and locks a 400 token bond for 60 epochs, 100 percent slashed if the same credential spawns a second identity. Anyone can check a nullifier against the public registry in seconds, and a per-funder tally freezes every identity a sponsor funded once a third duplicate surfaces. Behind each identity a plume of graded work grows from zero, so a fresh fake earns nothing until it survives several epochs of honest grading. 1,000 fakes cost 400,000 tokens upfront.
